*A nationally acclaimed restaurant employing traditional Mexican cooking techniques, local Texas ingredients & housemade masa to bring you weekend brunch and daily happy hour and dinner service.*


Suerte is a restaurant inspired by the people, cooking techniques, and flavors of Mexico. Nationally acclaimed Chef Fermin Nunez and his team pride themselves on the use of local ingredients from our beloved farmers to achieve something delicious and uniquely East Austin.

## Executive Chef Fermin Nunez

A native of Torreon, Mexico, Chef Fermin Nunez is influenced by the flavors of his home country and has dedicated himself to finding creative ways of translating these flavors into unique and exciting dishes throughout his career. After moving to Austin in 2009, Chef Fermin spent the last decade in Austin at local favorites such as Launderette, La Condesa, and Uchiko, where he honed his style before opening Suerte with restaurateur Samuel Hellman-Mass.

Chef Fermin has established himself as an industry leader both locally and nationally. Recently named among Food & Wine's Best Chefs, Núñez was also named Eater Austin Chef of the Year in 2018 and has been featured on Food Network, Netflix’s The Taco Chronicles, The Wall Street Journal, New York Times, and Texas Monthly.

# Reserve a Table

Reserve a Table

We accept online reservations of up to 9 guests for dinner and weekend brunch. Reservations are released up to 30 days in advance through OpenTable for both our main dining room and covered patio. Patio reservations are weather permitting and are subject to change.

*We do not allow pets in any areas of our restaurant including our outdoor seating areas.*

Reservations will be held for 15 minutes past the stated time before being released. Special requests such as highchairs, strollers, or additional seating preferences should be noted at the time of booking and we will accommodate to the best of our ability.

*All available reservations are listed online but we always save a portion of our seating for walk-in guests at our bar, in our dining room, and outdoors. We ask that you check in with our hosts in person to add your name to our waitlist.*

***We provide limited onsite parking and offer partial validation at the LAZ parking garage (1801 E 6th Street), located directly across the street from Suerte.***

## Large Party Reservations

For parties of 10 or more, we offer a large party dining experience in our semi-private dining room or outdoor covered deck. Please complete the inquiry form below and our reservations team will reach out promptly.

All inquiries are answered internally in the order they are received within 24 to 48 hours.

# Large Party Dining

*Tiempo de celebrar?* Suerte offers a variety of spaces that can accommodate larger groups with a seasonally curated menu by Chef Fermin Nunez. For parties of 10 or more, please fill out the form below to further inquire about our large party dining experience!

 To ensure we create the perfect experience for you, please give us at least one week’s notice. All requests are considered on a first come, first serve basis. Thank you for your understanding, and we can’t wait to celebrate with you!

Inquire Now

* ## Semi-Private Dining Room

  Our semi-private dining room can accommodate up to 20 guests at a single table or up to 24 guests at 3 adjacent tables.
  For additional privacy, the room can be closed off from our main dining room by a sliding fabric partition for groups of 24 or less.

  **Capacity:** 24 guests
* ## Outdoor Covered Deck

  This covered outdoor space overlooks historic 6th street and is ideal for seated and standing events.

  The deck has two built-in banquets that can accommodate up to 20 guests each for seated events and floor plans are available to accommodate standing cocktail events. The deck is equipped with retractable shades, fans, and misters.

  **Capacity:** 36 seated// 50 standing
* ## Full Restaurant Buyout

  For those looking for exclusive access to the entire restaurant, we offer full buyouts that can be curated to your needs, your guests, and your event. This is a great option for larger groups looking for a private experience. Guests will have access to every restaurant space including our covered deck, E 6th patio and cocktail and bar area.
  We offer a variety of table arrangements to accommodate your style of event. Our events team can help coordinate AV, music, and decor. Custom a la carte experiences can be added such as cooking classes, mezcal tastings, and beverage pairing packages as requested.

  **Capacity:** 100 seated// 100 standing

## Taco Bar Experience

Suerte's taco bar catering menu features our most popular taco offerings, chips y dips, and a la carte sides. Available for pick up, drop off, and full service events!

## Full Service Catering

Suerte's full service catering menus offer a selection of favorites served family-style for seated experiences and à la carte small bites for social events. Bar services featuring signature cocktails are also available upon request!

Full service catering includes food and beverage setup/breakdown, staffing, and pre-event coordination.

Yes, we reserve a portion of our restaurant to accommodate walk-ins on a first-come, first-serve basis.

During peak hours our wait time can average from fifteen mins to an hour and a half. We encourage you to check in with our host stand who can give you an updated wait time when you arrive. Once you’ve been added to our waitlist you can enjoy cocktails in our wait area or explore the neighborhood and we will text you when your table is ready!

Our booking window opens up 30 days in advance at midnight via Resy. Larger parties of 10 or more guests can be reserved up to three months in advance.

Yes, we have a small waiting area with cocktail service.

We love dogs but only ADA service animals trained to perform a specific task to assist a person with a disability are allowed in the restaurant and on our patio.

Yes. We allow outside desserts with a cake cutting fee of $25

Our liquor license does not allow outside beverages but we have a full bar which offers a carefully curated agave spirit selection, signature cocktails, and natural wines.

You can make a reservation for up to 9 guests in our main dining room and up to 6 guests on our patio. For reservations of 10 or more guests, an “omakase” dining experience in our private dining room is available. A minimum cost spent and non-refundable deposit is required to reserve this space. There is a food and beverage minimum and non-refundable deposit is required to reserve this space.

Yes, at this time this is our only offering for parties of 10 or more. We are dedicated to providing you with exceptional dining for any celebration and believe our semi-private dining room offers the level of hospitality that best accommodates large groups. We are happy to work with you and your guests to curate a unique experience!

If you are looking for an experience other than a semi private dining room, please check our online availability to book a standard reservation.

At this time we do not offer valet service. We provide limited onsite parking and offer partial validation at the LAZ parking garage (1801 E 6th Street), located directly across the street from Suerte.

There is no dress code.

Yes, we offer online catering orders for pickup or drop-off through a third-party delivery service, as well as full-service catering. Both options are subject to availability! For more information, please click [HERE](https://www.suerteatx.com/catering/).

We are happy to accommodate most dietary restrictions and aversions, but there are some limitations due to the nature of our menu. If any of your guests have requests for accommodations, please let us know prior to confirming your reservation.

# Careers

Our training program sets clear expectations for each member of our familia and allows them to further their knowledge not only of Mexican cuisine and spirits but of hospitality overall.  We are continuously working to cultivate a team and work environment that allows each staff member to feel supported and part of a community.

If you are interested in joining our familia, please fill out the form below or send us an email to [hola@suerteatx.com](mailto:hola@suerteatx.com). We are always looking for team-oriented cooks and front of house staff who share our passion for genuine hospitality. We look forward to hearing from you!

*A nationally acclaimed restaurant employing traditional Mexican cooking techniques, local Texas ingredients & housemade masa to bring you weekend brunch and daily happy hour and dinner service.*


Located in the heart of East Austin, Suerte is an award-winning restaurant driven by a passion for masa,  an ingredient at the heart of Mexican cooking. Chef Fermin and his team curate a seasonally driven menu with an emphasis on bringing together traditional Mexican cooking techniques with local Texas ingredients to create a unique and exciting dining experience.

Our bar offers some of Mexico's most unique agave and succulent spirits state-side, as well as highlighting a rotating selection of natural wines and craft cocktails.

From the open dining room adorned with art and textiles, to a patio that overlooks East 6th Street, Suerte offers a vibrant environment for any fiesta.

Our team believes hospitality prevails, homemade masa reigns and every day can be an occasion to celebrate!
